page: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 6226R processor running at 2.9 GHz. The system provides 30 dedicated physical cores with 30 vCPUs, operating without hyperthreading at one thread per core. For acceleration, the instance is equipped with two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs, delivering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. System memory consists of 90.0 GB of RAM, translating to 3.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a 500 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-threaded performance and exceptional capabilities in large language model inference. The multi-threaded bzip3 decompression benchmark reached 228.36 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% tier. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier performance in the top 10% across multiple model sizes, with prompt processing speeds of 17320.17 tokens/sec for a 135M model, 1423.03 tokens/sec for a 7B model, and 151.96 tokens/sec for a 70B model. Text generation speeds also rank highly, achieving 131.54 tokens/sec on the 7B model and 18.65 tokens/sec on the 70B model. Standard CPU and memory benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU scores, fall within the average range.

The inclusion of dedicated physical cores and dual enterprise-grade GPUs makes this instance a cost-effective option for workloads requiring sustained parallel processing without the overhead of hyperthreading. The hardware profile is highly suited for machine learning tasks, specifically LLM inference, deep learning training, and complex scientific simulations. It is also well-suited for video rendering, data parallel processing, and high-performance computing applications that can leverage the dual NVIDIA V100S GPUs and NVMe-backed local storage.
